Counting the almonds on the plate gives about 20.

Almonds weigh roughly 1.2 g each, so 20 almonds come to about 24 g.

At about 5.8 kcal per gram, that is roughly 139 kcal. The small orange bit, possibly a carrot shred or a sauce remnant, adds a negligible amount.
